decision.completeness_basis: Undergraduate Majors, Minors, and Certificates page on catalog.spu.edu (2026-2027 Edition): counted 69 bachelor's entries labeled (BA)/(BS); SPU lists each track/concentration/certification variant as its own major entry with its own page and our records are keyed per entry, so entries were counted as listed (Student-Designed (BA) or (BS) once). Excluded minors, certification-only programs, AI and Society (stated 'not a major'), Pre-Professional Health Sciences and special programs. 50 of 69 have verified records.
decision.reason: Catalog-count review 2026-10-06: official current list page.
